name: Garmin
author: n1byn1kt
description: Your Garmin day in the bar: a configurable metric chip (Body Battery, steps, sleep, or readiness) and a panel of customizable cards — day curve, sleep, steps, readiness, weight, HRV, and more.

barWidget.description: Health chip — Body Battery, steps, sleep or readiness; click for the full panel

schema.label: Bar metric: bodyBattery, steps, sleep or readiness (default bodyBattery; the panel's edit mode overrides this)
Show steps next to the bar metric (ignored when the bar metric is steps)
Step goal if Garmin doesn't provide one
Panel cards, comma-separated and in order: curve, battery, sleep, steps, readiness, rhr, hrv, intensity, floors, calories, weight, activity, custom (the panel's edit mode overrides this)
Command for the 'custom' card — must print one JSON object: {title, value, caption, meter:{value,max}, tone}
